# iosxe_voice_class_server_group (Resource)

This resource can manage the Voice Class Server Group configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_voice_class_server_group" "example" {
  tag = 200
  ipv4 = [
    {
      address = "192.0.2.10"
    }
  ]
  ipv4_with_port = [
    {
      address = "192.0.2.20"
      port    = 5061
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) Voice class server group tag
  - Range: `1`-`10000`

### Optional

- `delete_mode` (String) Configure behavior when deleting/destroying the resource. Either delete the entire object (YANG container) being managed, or only delete the individual resource attributes configured explicitly and leave everything else as-is. Default value is `all`.
  - Choices: `all`, `attributes`
- `description` (String) Description of a dialpeer group
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `hunt_scheme_round_robin` (Boolean) Servers are sorted in round robin
- `ipv4` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv4))
- `ipv4_with_port` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv4_with_port))
- `shutdown` (Boolean) Put server group to inactive state

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

<a id="nestedatt--ipv4"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipv4`

Required:

- `address` (String) set the Call Manager configuration download TFTP server address/name

Optional:

- `preference` (Number) Preference order of this server in a group
  - Range: `0`-`5`


<a id="nestedatt--ipv4_with_port"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipv4_with_port`

Required:

- `address` (String) set the Call Manager configuration download TFTP server address/name
- `port` (Number) IP Address Port
  - Range: `1`-`65535`

Optional:

- `preference` (Number) Preference order of this server in a group
  - Range: `0`-`5`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_voice_class_server_group.example "<tag>"
```
